full_page.content:
1957, April 6
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.P.M. Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE MONASTERY 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue DETROIT 7, MICHIGAN Blessed be God in all His designs.
April 6th, 1957
The Corcoran Publishing Company O.P. 174 Albuquerque, New Mexico My dear Friends:
God bless you and yours these unsettled, though by the mercy of God, greately privileged days. I am sure we all here at the Monastery hope that things in general at least are going fairly well your way and with your business.
I received notice from your establishment several years ago, anouncing your having taken over the publication of the divinely privileged - "inspired" Life of the Bl. Virgin Mary; the Mysti- cal City of God. I hardly remember the particulars of the situ- ation at the time but I've regretted since, my comparative in- activity in such a divinely privileged work.
(Unfinished draft)
